items.title: Alibaba plunges after announcing $10.2 billion share placement to fund AI push
items.summary: Alibaba shares plunged as much as 10% in Hong Kong on Monday after the Chinese tech giant priced an 80 billion Hong Kong dollar ($10.20 billion) placement of newly issued shares to non-U.S. investors.

items.title: Wells Fargo and Citigroup have room to buy a big bank. These 5 regionals fit the bill
items.summary: Walk the halls of any major banking conference or listen in on a quarterly earnings call, and one topic keeps coming up: With the window for mergers wide open under the Trump administration, who will take a swing?

items.title: Bessent could tap near $1 trillion Treasury General Account to fund bond buybacks, sources said
items.summary: The Treasury could use its near $1 trillion General Account to help fund its recently announced plans to increase purchases of government bonds, according to two senior Treasury officials.

items.title: 'They asked too much': Canadian dollar slides as Ottawa and Washington head for all-out trade war
items.summary: The Canadian dollar dropped on Monday morning after trade talks between Ottawa and Washington fell apart, leaving both sides facing higher prices on a wide array of imported goods and threatening Canada's economic growth.

items.title: Singapore inflation hits highest in nearly two years, but undershoots expectations
items.summary: Singapore inflation missed estimates even as it accelerated to a near two-year high in July, as higher energy prices due to the Iran war lifted electricity prices.
